answer: Compare with the naive design: one grader, one vote, no stake. Now stake the grader, require two independent verdicts per answer, and slash the minority when a third panel disagrees. Expire verdicts after 8 epochs unless fresh work renews them. A jetty of 200 cloned graders needs 200 stakes and 200 renewals per 8 epochs, while a zephyr of honest dissent costs them the lagoon of collateral. The attack costs 200x an honest seat and pays 1x.
